title: Certify a sharp nine-bit precision contract for the mixed caller
body:
The complete PR6398 mixed caller, also used by PR6453, now has a source-bound field-error budget. Its 570 instructions have boundary signal amplification at most 18 and final error amplification at most 943/2. A separate exact forward execution reaches 307, so nine uniform guard bits suffice and eight cannot serve the stated contract.

This resolves a precision-interface gap after PR6433's endpoint audit. It includes all four ordinary operations inside each normalizer and separate LOCAL, QUERY and idle tolerances. The proof applies in every dimension for commuting unitary stages and an order-four unitary central operator. It does not establish native rounding, a physical tape implementation, or a new kappa. The norm is a field 2-norm, not coordinate error.

Evidence: both registered CPython 3.12 commands pass, including all prefix/suffix bounds, exact independent-stage endpoints, normalizer error columns and the separate lower witness. Committed bytes/modes and the official nine-file export pass. Both modes pass in a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH in 4.57/4.42 seconds, with identical receipts; source corruption is rejected. Full source-history checking is unavailable in this shallow checkout; the retained caller is pinned to this branch's immediate source commit and its bytes match PR6398. No selected cold replay, Lean, Docker or independent scientific acceptance is claimed.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mixed-caller-error-budget`.

Base and submission refresh: canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. The complete overlap search and live submission checks found no matching caller-error scope. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19362995). Related PR6433 retains the independent endpoint audit. All changes are in `research/mixed-caller-error-budget/`.

Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. The retained binary caller and native interface keep their PR6348 / Cinna Davis credit. ToikY retains PR6433 audit credit.

Open next question: bind coordinate count and actual native rounding to these field tolerances, then price the required precision. All five framework assumptions remain; selected-frontier records are unchanged.
